STANDARDS & CYBERNETIC SECURITY

ISO Compliance & Data Governance

Engineered from day one to satisfy rigorous international standards for security, privacy, cloud persistence, and agentic AI oversight.

Security Base 100% Control Mapping

ISO 27001:2022

Information Security Management System (ISMS)

End-to-end cryptographic protection (AES-256-GCM / ML-KEM-768), strict role-based access control (RBAC), and hardware vault isolation.

✔ By-Design Architecture
Privacy Sovereign Local-First Architecture

ISO 27701:2019

Privacy Information Management System (PIMS)

Guaranteed zero PII exfiltration. User data is processed on-device and never shared or aggregated without explicit local consent.

✔ By-Design Architecture
Cloud Zero-Knowledge Zero-Knowledge Persistence

ISO 27017 / 27018

Cloud Security & PII Protection in Cloud

Cloud persistence nodes store only encrypted raw bytes. Storage providers possess zero capability to inspect or parse payload data.

✔ By-Design Architecture
AI Governance Human-in-the-Loop AI

ISO 42001:2023

Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS)

Deterministic audit trails for all agentic decisions. AI agents advise and coordinate but never hold unilateral voting authority.

✔ By-Design Architecture

Private Mesh & Tor / Onion Transport Layer

SWAL allows any collective, enterprise, or community to spin up private encrypted P2P mesh networks spanning from 1 to thousands of nodes. Network packets utilize end-to-end ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption, optional Tor / Onion transport routing, and post-quantum ML-KEM encapsulation, ensuring complete resistance against eavesdropping, ISP tracking, and traffic analysis.

Private Mallas (1-N)
Isolated subnets for closed teams
Onion Transport
Tor-hidden routing for peer discovery
Role-Based ACL
Least-privilege cybernetic access
COMPUTE & PERSISTENCE

Local GPU Inference & Cloud Membership

Zero software paywalls. Compute runs locally whenever hardware is present. Cloud persistence is billed strictly at direct infrastructure cost.

⚡
100% Free & Private

Local GPU Acceleration

WebGPU · wgpu · Ollama · llama.cpp

If your device is equipped with a dedicated or integrated GPU (NVIDIA RTX, Apple Silicon M-series, AMD, Vulkan), SWAL applications run LLM and visual inference locally. Your prompts, embeddings, and context never leave your silicon.
